narration.text: Number one on this list made my click-through rate jump by 15%.

Coming in at number five is Simplified. This tool offers decent AI template suggestions for those starting out. It is easy to use for quick, basic designs, perfect if you need something fast without much fuss.
Number four, Lightricks Create. Its AI excels at background removal and manipulating objects in your image. It gives you precise control, allowing for really clean and professional-looking cut-outs.

At number three, we have Canva Magic Design. This is fantastic for adding text overlays and ensuring good visual hierarchy. Its AI helps place elements effectively, making your thumbnails clear and impactful.
The runner-up is Designs.ai. This AI generates multiple unique thumbnail options from your input quickly. It is a great way to get diverse ideas and explore different styles without much effort.

And the top spot, number one, goes to Thumbnail Test. This tool doesn't just design thumbnails, it optimises them for actual viewer engagement and clicks. It uses data to predict what will perform best.
Thumbnail Test is truly revolutionary for optimising your YouTube channel. Do you think any other AI thumbnail maker deserves a spot on this list?
